'''Dren Nord''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]] as a [[Doctor/Legends|surgeon]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He requested a transfer to [[Alliance Special Operations/Legends|Alliance Special Operations]], and was placed under the command of [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[T'Charek Haathi]].

==Biography==
The youngest of four children, Nord grew up in a family of politicians. He used his connections to get into one of the best medical schools in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] and prestigious intern positions. After the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction of Alderaan]], he was recruited by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] to head up a surgery team on a [[Hospital ship/Legends|medical frigate]]. While attending to an attractive patient, he learned that she was more impressed by [[Alliance Special Operations/Legends|Alliance Special Operations]] than by medical personnel. This caused Nord to request to be transferred. He used his connections to get assigned to [[T'Charek Haathi's Special Ops team|Haathi's team]] despite his lack of combat skills.<ref name="AJ13" />

===Mission on Zelos II===
Nord was on [[Zelos II]] with the rest of his team to steal a [[Starship/Legends|ship]]. While [[Ivhin Jayme]] and [[Morgan Q. Raventhorn]] hacked the security systems, he kept an eye on guards patrolling the [[Spaceport/Legends|starport]]. Being new at field work, he questioned Haathi about her plan to steal the [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighter]] ''[[The Maker (YT-1300 light freighter)|The Maker]]''. He was nervous about her fixation on the freighter even though it was more closely guarded than other ships in the starport. After Jayme was able to get into the docking bay, he let Nord and the rest of the team in so they could bypass the freighter's security systems and steal it. Nord took cover by a crate and watched the guards to make sure they didn't notice the team. He was concerned that Haathi was taking too many risks and attempted to get Jayme to talk some sense into her. After Haathi was knocked out by the [[Ramp Entry Security System|stun steps]] on the boarding ramp to the freighter, Nord came out of cover to see if she needed medical assistance. This led him to being spotted by the guards who opened fire on the team. During the [[Lightfight|blaster fight]], Nord panicked and changed his blaster settings from [[Stun/Legends|stun]] to kill. Haathi ordered him to change it back and told Jayme to stun the medic if he didn't comply. Nord went back to non-lethal fire, and quickly ran onto the freighter when Haathi ordered her team to get onboard. He went and hid in the back storage bay of the freighter.<ref name="AJ13" />

==Personality and traits==
Dren Nord was an attractive male and used this to his advantage when making political connections. He was not good at giving or receiving order outside of the operating room and was not particularly adept at combat.<ref name="AJ13" />
